entry.title: New: dsh-plugin-finance-data
entry.summary: Finance data toolkit for DSH agents: number and currency formatting (incl. Chinese wan/yi units), return and CAGR math, valuation and profitability ratios, PV/FV, risk metrics, and a data-quality checklist. Exact install spec: dsh-plugin-finance-data. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
